name: ultra braille
description: Proposal, 60 cells. Ultracode as a large rotating sphere of braille dots, and the creature wears the colours of the sphere on the way in and out: a colour glitch (rainbow and neon purple slices sliding sideways over a magenta and cyan split), then the body tints by column in the longitude bands of the sphere and crumbles into 2x2 braille dots that fly into it while the eyes hold to the last; it turns on a tilted axis in rainbow bands with the back side neon purple, then plays the way in backwards, the dots landing tinted and settling to pure teal; judge whether glitch, body and sphere now read as one colour story.
